requirement.original: sync-agent-data.py reports 'no data changes needed' but the HTML still shows stale/old Day 1 timeline data
requirement.clarified: The sync script's _load_config() method fails to detect meal types because it looks for '$ref: #/$defs/meal_item' in the meals schema, but the schema was refactored to use '$ref: #/$defs/meal_slot'. This causes _sync_meals to iterate over zero meal types, never updating meals.json. The HTML generator reads from meals.json, so stale times persist.
requirement.why: Meal times in meals.json are never synced from timeline.json, causing stale data in generated HTML

included: Verify sync correctly updates meals.json after fix
Regenerate HTML to confirm correct times
excluded: Refactoring HTML generator to read from timeline.json directly

success_criteria: sync-agent-data.py reports timeline injections for meals with stale times
meals.json Day 1 lunch time updated from 15:10-15:40 to 13:00-13:40
Generated HTML shows correct meal times

root_cause_analysis.symptom: sync-agent-data.py reports '0 changes needed' for meals, but meals.json has stale times (15:10-15:40) while timeline.json has correct times (13:00-13:40)
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: _load_config() on line 63 checks for '$ref' == '#/$defs/meal_item' in meals schema day_entry properties, but schema was refactored to use '#/$defs/meal_slot' wrapper. Result: meal_types = [] (empty list), so _sync_meals iterates over zero types.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - schema refactored separately from sync script, mismatch was never caught
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The meals schema was correctly refactored to add meal_slot (with primary + alternatives), but sync-agent-data.py was not updated to match the new $ref
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Zero meal types means _sync_meals does nothing. All meal data in meals.json stays stale. HTML generator reads meals.json, so HTML shows old times.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Bug has existed since the meal_slot schema refactor

context.codebase_state: timeline.json has correct data (Heyan Meat Pie lunch 13:00-13:40 with meal_ref=lunch), meals.json has stale data (15:10-15:40)

file_contents.scripts/sync-agent-data.py:64-65: meal_types = [k for k, v in day_props.items() if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("$ref") == meal_item_ref]

development_approach.strategy: Change the $ref comparison string from '#/$defs/meal_item' to '#/$defs/meal_slot' in _load_config(). Then run sync and verify meals.json is updated.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1. Run sync --dry-run and verify timeline_injections > 0 for meals. 2. Run sync without dry-run and verify meals.json Day 1 lunch time is 13:00-13:40. 3. Regenerate HTML and verify correct times.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause - schema ref mismatch
